journey.name: pair primary node
journey.description: Proves primary node editing, validation, pairing and persistence in the Android native LDK wallet. Preconditions: an onboarded regtest wallet, a compatible Beignet or ldk-node provider on the same chain, and its full publickey@host:port URI in a QR fixture. The provider must have its liquidity provider enabled and be reachable from the device, but have no spendable onchain funds. Pairing verifies protocol support without requiring liquidity for a sample receive. For the Android emulator, use 10.0.2.2 for a provider listening on the host. The wallet Electrum server must use the same regtest chain. iOS does not yet have this primary node flow, so this journey is Android-only.

actions.action: Open Settings and select the General tab
Tap the Primary node row with tag "PrimaryNodeSettings"
Verify the primary node screen with tag "PrimaryNodeScreen" is visible
Enter "invalid" in the field with tag "PrimaryNodeInput"
Tap the button with tag "PrimaryNodeConnect"
Verify an inline validation error with tag "PrimaryNodeError" is visible
Tap the scan button with tag "PrimaryNodeScan" and scan the provider URI fixture
Verify the field with tag "PrimaryNodeInput" contains the complete provider URI
Verify the primary node has not connected merely from scanning the fixture
Tap the button with tag "PrimaryNodeConnect"
Wait for primary node setup to finish
Verify the successful setup message with tag "PrimaryNodeConnected" is visible
Verify the current primary with tag "PrimaryNodeCurrent" matches the provider URI
Leave the primary node screen and reopen it from Settings
Verify the current primary still matches the provider URI
Return to Home and verify the setup banner with tag "HomePrimaryNode" is absent
Fully close and reopen the app, then verify the Home setup banner remains absent
Stop the disposable provider and verify the Home setup banner remains absent while that primary is offline
Restart the same provider, open Settings, and tap the row with tag "PrimaryNodeSettings"
Verify the primary node screen and saved provider URI are still available from Settings
